storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
How could we ever forget the hero Uvhash? He was the finest of men. The warrior fell to his knees in the sunset-drenched sands, his body bathed in warm blood. Vultures circled above, singing his dirge:
<Italic:No tears shall honor you, no weeping shall lay you to rest,
For in life, your name had already conquered Rome.>

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Silver Core Number: B-005
Date of Excavation: @3, A.F.1@1
Excavation Site: Rural Flemish Lowlands—ruins of an unnamed ancient Roman mausoleum
Detailed Record: The core's original bearer, Ludwig Prynn, was sentenced to burn at the stake by the local Inquisition following a necromancy incident. Prynn claimed to have acquired this Silver Core on the battlefields of the Ninth Holy Crusade. He then traveled to the outskirts of Brabantum, where, alongside his "Servant from the Stars" and "Invisible Companion," he conducted blood rites to summon the "Great Unnamable."

Recorder: Ward Philips
—<Italic:Awakener Silver Core Acquisition Report: B-005>

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
"4:30 6-mile morning jog along the Aethis River. Argued with an elderly passerby and kicked a poodle into the air.

...

12:00 Lunch: Honey pancakes, olive appetizers, and... five servings of roast lamb? Unbelievable.

13:00 Headed to the Trout Fighting Club. Record: 10 wins, 0 losses. Fastest match: 3 seconds—the opponent forfeited out of sheer fear.

19:00 Watched <Italic:The Shepherd-King> at Corvint Theatre with the Keeper, got thrown out for shouting dangerous political opinions.

22:00 Found loitering near St. Marian Hospital. Highly probable motive: casing the facility for blood bags theft.

Observation ends; danger level: SSS."

—Excerpt from <Italic:Hannah's Awakener Observation Notes>

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
A "golem" forged by Caligura's court alchemist, Marcus Antys, at the cost of countless living souls.

Due to the imperfection of the alchemical ritual, he had to drink a large amount of blood daily. He killed Caligura's political enemies and helped him claim the throne of Rome.

The tyrant Caligura was murdered less than four years into his reign. The golem was also locked in the underground of the destroyed altar by enraged and fearful mobs, forced to endure hunger and thirst for nearly a thousand years.

Throughout the long centuries, he survived on the blood of rats. The thirst ingrained deep within his nature slowly drove him mad.

<Italic:Not enough, far from enough...>
During the @2 period, a Lavantian sorcerer found him, promising to free him on one condition: he must slaughter the Remouans on the battlefield.

<Italic:A deal like that? How could he refuse.>
He completed the task with ease, but there was a small complication: in his frenzy, he slaughtered every soul on the battlefield and drained them dry—including the sorcerer, and ultimately, himself.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Age@2, the ancient city of Akka.

A thousand years of thirst finally broke loose—kill, drink, kill, drink—until nothing remained before him but an endless desert and a vast litter of desiccated corpses, so dreadful a sight that even the vultures dared not draw near.

He knelt in the yellow sand and laughed, and laughed, and laughed.

Glorious! @1 glorious!

And now—he would crown this magnificent feast of slaughter with his own blood.

The warrior bit open his own wrist, drained himself dry, and collapsed at last into the vast crimson pool he had made.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: How many times have I been summoned... Human, you'd better have enough 'food' ready, or I can't guarantee anything.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: The power surges, nonstop, filling my whole body...

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: I'm really, really excited right now... If you still want to live, better stay away from me.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Not bad. You're less worthless than you appear.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Hey, stop meddling with my body. True warriors never rely on external aids.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: This strange feeling... not bad. Better than that Levantine wizard's nightshade.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Well done, Keeper. So, who am I killing this time?

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Hahaha, that's the feeling! Give me more... double, no, ten times the dose!

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Crimson body, pulsating tentacles, mouthparts constantly opening and closing... Great! I can't wait to tear a throat apart!

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Worms. Stars. I am... Uvhash! Kill... let me kill!

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Scared? Hahaha, that's right! To hell with everything. I just want to savor your fear.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Interesting, your blood tastes... sweet, like mead.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Back then, tens of thousands cheered my name. The loud roars of "Uvhash" drowned everything else, celebrating me breaking a bald weakling's neck. It felt incredible. As my partner, you should understand.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Shackle me, drag me by the hair, make me kneel as your slave... I don't care, do anything to me as you please. Just let me kill. The Sculptors, that Lady Lantern, some random hag with asthma... anyone! I promise I'll tear their throats out and drink their blood.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Frail human, your conviction is sufficient. I will be your weapon. Let's carve out some chaos together!

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Touch me all you like... These are the scars I earned at the arena, a man's badges of honor!

daily.title: Chat: About Etiquette
daily.content: Top hats, bowler hats, deerstalker hats, berets... Gotta say it's funny how those high and mighty "gentlemen" would do everything to hide their bald heads.

daily.title: Chat: About Agrippa
daily.content: Agrippa? Who was that? Oops, I've killed too many. Most of them weren't worth remembering.

daily.title: Chat: About Leigh
daily.content: Who is Leigh? Oh, the woman who begged me to beat her up. Haha, interesting... This place isn't boring after all.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: I've seen many go mad from Dissolution. Truth is, I'm already mad enough. Bet that thing can't affect me.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Don't expect to find me in the teaching building. It stinks of musty old scholars; I can't stand that place.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: After Tiberius's death, the Romans finally had their long-time wish granted: they got to dump him into the Tiber to feed the fish. The price was small: Caligula threw those people to me in the arena for my amusement.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: You call this little toy a handgun? Hiding in shadows to ambush enemies... Hmph. A weapon for cowards only.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Want to please me? Then kneel, offer your neck, and shut up until I finish draining you.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: I smell... the scent of blood.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: I'm not done yet... How about you get up so I can kill you again?

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: The thrill of battle beats everything—not even winning comes close.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: I am the last Roman warrior—Uvhash!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Enjoy this feast of slaughter! To the fullest!
